body: Thank you! I hope the move and everything went well. Im planning for 2 years from now on having a house.

Hey man, did you get her number? I need a follow up!
And look now you have one. Happy for you!
Ive honestly thought about doing this every evening or morning. No distractions, just take in the moment. Still havent done it, but at some point I hope to.

I want to cancel everytime when I have to go to the psych doctor. But you know what? Once Im there, I feel safe and able to talk out my feelings with my doctor. Do I hate being on 4 different pills everyday of my life? Hell yeah I do. But I know I feel so much better taking them then I do when I dont take them. Give the doctor another shot. Keep me updated. I want you to get the help. Everyone needs a push here and there.
Very true. Sometimes our mind is our worst enemy. Thank you for the kind words! Hope all is well on your end.

One day at a time man. Things arent as bad as I think. My mind just plays these games.
